title: Surface words block re-centres when the summon button arrives
body:
## Summary
When a card starts waiting, the surface mounts "Open her window to answer (n)" inside a vertically centred grid, so the eyebrow, marquee, line and ask row all jump up by half the button's height in one frame.

## Description
`.surface__words` is `align-self: center` in the first grid row (apps/desktop/src/scenes/surface/surface.css:26-31) and the summon button is conditionally rendered between the line and the ask form (apps/desktop/src/scenes/surface/view.tsx:68-72 `{model.waiting > 0 && (<button ...>)}`). Adding ~40px (padding 8px 16px plus a line, surface.css:57-60) to a centred block moves every sibling by ~20px at the moment the person's attention is drawn there, and the ask field under the pointer or the caret moves with it; the reverse jump happens when the last card is answered. Registry motion/continuity-across-change: a state change rendered by inserting an element should not move what the reader is engaged with. Fixed looks like either a reserved slot (the row is always laid out, its content fades in on opacity) or a keyed enter that does not re-centre the block; which one is a design call, and either must be seen in the window.

## Flow
- the person is on the surface, typing in the ask field, Athena idle (waiting = 0)
- a card arrives: athena:status cards 0 -> 1, `model.waiting > 0` mounts the summon button
- `.surface__words` re-centres: marquee, line and ask row shift up ~20px in one frame; the reverse on answer
- proposal: reserve the summon row (min-height on a wrapper, content opacity 0 -> 1 on the depth clock, Calm 0 ms), pin it in surface.css.test.ts, run perf:surface, then check in the real window at 900x600 and full size

## Expected impact
Anyone working on the surface when a decision arrives stops seeing the words and the field jump; measured as the block's top offset before and after a card arrives (0 px shift after). A reserved slot adds ~40px of empty space when nothing waits, which is the design call.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the words block holds still when a card arrives and when it is answered
Before: ~20px shift of .surface__words siblings per arrival (half of a ~40px button in a centred block), walked from the CSS
After: 0px under a reserved slot; not measured
Method: simulation - the shift is computed from surface.css:26-60 and view.tsx:68; a layout figure needs a rendered window (jsdom has no layout), and the reserve-vs-enter choice is a design call
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction

title: Mind and surface stylesheets space with one-off pixels beside a token-pinned twin
body:
## Summary
mind.css and surface.css lay out their fields, tiles and rows with literal 4/6/9/10/14/18px gaps and pads, while engine.css in the same scenes is pinned to the density tokens by a test.

## Description
The overlay's rule is tokens only (spacing from app.css: --density-gap 16px, --density-pad 16px, --density-pad-sm 12px, plus the 8px inner gap EngineSection.test.tsx allows). apps/desktop/src/scenes/shared/engine.css follows it and EngineSection.test.tsx:53-61 fails on any one-off pad. mind.css outside the theme miniature has 13 gap/padding literals off that set (mind.css:10 gap 18px, :60 gap 10px, :67 gap 4px, :68 padding 10px 8px 14px, :95 gap 6px, :97 padding 12px 14px, :123 gap 6px, :133 gap 14px, :150 gap 10px, :156 padding 9px 14px, :169 padding 8px 12px), and surface.css has 9 (surface.css:60 padding 8px 16px, :74 gap 6px, :75 margin-top 8px, :89 padding 10px 14px, :104 padding 10px 18px, :145 gap 2px, :146 padding 10px 6px 12px). Two sibling scenes and the engine section inside one of them therefore space the same kinds of things differently (the tile field's 10px against the engine list's 12px). Fixed: each value moved to the nearest token (or the 8px inner step) and the EngineSection spacing pin applied to both stylesheets.

## Flow
- build the instrument first: copy the spacing test of EngineSection.test.tsx:53-61 into mind.css.test.ts and surface.css.test.ts (comment-stripped); watch it fail with the 22 values above
- move each value to --density-pad-sm / --density-gap / 8px; re-run the pins green
- run perf:mind and perf:surface, then screenshot the field, a level and the surface at 900x600 and full size in both themes and compare against the current tree

## Expected impact
Sibling surfaces stop disagreeing about rhythm; measured as off-token spacing literals 22 -> 0 under the pin. Every tile and row moves by 1-6px, so the field's fit at the smallest window can change: that is why it needs the screenshots.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - spacing in the two scenes obeys the density scale the engine section already obeys
Before: 22 gap/padding literals off the token set (13 in mind.css outside the miniature, 9 in surface.css), counted by grep on comment-stripped CSS
After: 0 under the ported pin; the visual effect is not measured
Method: probe - the count is a grep over both files; the change's visual cost needs a rendered window at two sizes and two themes, which this round has not
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: EngineSection.test.tsx's spacing pin ported to mind.css.test.ts and surface.css.test.ts (seeded red by the 22 literals), plus perf:mind/perf:surface and before/after screenshots of the Mind field, a level and the surface at 900x600 and full size in both themes
